note: Edit numbers here, no code change needed. Sources: NASA Game Data Book (physics.json). Values marked GAME are tuned for play, not real hardware.

grow.name: Tend hydroponics
grow.info: The tray yields 2 kg of fresh food. One day of supplies was used.

study.name: Study samples
study.info: The crew studies the samples in transit (+5 science).

prep.name: Prepare the EVA
prep.info: Suits and tools are checked. Hull stress recovers by 8%.

options.name: Methalox
options.info: Isp ~360 s, can be made on Mars

options.name: Solar Array S 6 kW
options.info: Cheap, hurt by dust and flares

ice.name: Ice
ice.info: Water ice in permanently shadowed polar craters. LCROSS measured 5.6 +/- 2.9% water by mass in the Cabeus impact plume (NASA, 2009). Ice can be electrolysed into O2 and H2.

regolith.name: Regolith
regolith.info: The powdery rock layer covering the Moon. Apollo crews reported it was abrasive and a hazard to seals, visors and lungs.

ilmenite.name: Ilmenite
ilmenite.info: Ilmenite (FeTiO3) is a real lunar mineral. Hydrogen reduction of ilmenite is a NASA in-situ resource utilisation (ISRU) concept for making oxygen.

helium3.name: Helium-3
helium3.info: Helium-3 is implanted by the solar wind at extremely low concentration (parts per billion), so its value here is a game simplification.

missions.name: Moon - Lunar Ice Survey
missions.brief: Land near the south pole (Cabeus region), sample ice, return to the station. LCROSS measured 5.6 +/- 2.9 % water ice by mass there.
missions.environment: Vacuum, 1/6 Earth gravity, surface -173 C to +127 C. The south pole has permanently shadowed craters where ice survives.
hazards: Permanently shadowed craters are cold traps and hard to walk in
Abrasive regolith dust damages seals and visors
No atmosphere: every EVA is a suit life-support problem
gear: Scout drone (maps the landing zone, +25% EVA time)
ECLSS life support and a large storage locker
missions.scout_note: Without scout data the crew lands on the standard ellipse and gets the normal EVA window.

legs.name: Lunar orbit insertion
legs.note: Apollo 8 first flew this burn behind the Moon, out of radio contact with Earth.

legs.name: Powered descent
legs.note: Powered Descent Initiation (PDI): roughly 12 minutes of braking to reach the surface.

legs.name: Ascent + return to LEO
legs.note: The ascent stage lifts off and rendezvouses with the command module in lunar orbit.

missions.name: Mars - Gale Crater Base
missions.brief: Unlocked after the Moon. Full version: 4.3 km/s transfer, 0.9 capture, long transit, ISRU (MOXIE-style O2).
missions.environment: Thin CO2 atmosphere (6.36 mbar), 0.38 g, average -63 C. Solar output is about 43% of Earth's.
hazards: Long transit: 259 days each way plus a 454-day return window
Global dust storms reduce solar power
Perchlorates in the soil are toxic to plants and people
resources: Water ice in the polar caps and subsurface
gear: Fission power or oversized solar arrays
Radiation shelter for the long cruise
Closed-loop life support for a 900-day round trip
missions.scout_note: This prototype ends at the Moon; the Mars dossier is data-only so the team can show the plan.

events.title: Micrometeoroid Swarm
events.text: Sensors show a debris cloud crossing your path. Impact in 40 minutes.

choices.label: Evasive burn
choices.result: You dodge the cloud but spend propellant.

choices.label: Ride it out
choices.result: Impacts punch through the outer hull.

events.title: Solar Particle Event
events.text: A solar flare is arriving. Radiation will spike and solar panels lose output.

choices.label: Shelter in cabin (+1 day)
choices.result: Crew waits it out in the shielded area.

events.title: Communications Blackout
events.text: The antenna loses lock with Earth. Data packets are dropping.

choices.label: Wait for auto-recovery
choices.result: Link returns, but data was lost.

events.title: Supply Module Leak
events.text: Pressure drops in the storage locker. Consumables are venting.

choices.label: Seal the locker
choices.result: Leak stopped, a lot was lost.

events.title: Regolith Dust on Panels
events.text: Charged lunar dust clings to panels and seals (Apollo crews reported this).

choices.label: Drill anyway
choices.result: Extra samples, but power is reduced.

events.title: Ice Deposit Found
events.text: Neutron data hints at a rich ice pocket in a permanently shadowed crater.

events.title: Moonquake
events.text: Apollo seismometers proved moonquakes are real. The lander shakes.

station_modules.name: Helios Core
station_modules.effect: Controls the Helios smelter that is meant to cool Earth.

station_modules.name: Habitat
station_modules.effect: Crew quarters. Crew of 3 lives here.

station_modules.name: Greenhouse
station_modules.effect: Grow food for the crew (+60 kg storage)

station_modules.name: Exercise Bay
station_modules.effect: Crew keeps bone and muscle mass: +10% EVA stamina
